But what if you know you want to change
something but you don't feel like really
diving in there?
Well, the great thing is Pi is a coding
agent. It can work on your system, not just
in the project in which you open it, on your
entire system instead.
And therefore, if I see that I want to
change something here, let's say for the
Scout subagent here, which is there for

see what I need to change, or I grab a link

and ask Pi to
tweak the Scout subagent of the Pi subagents
package to use the GPT-5.4 model instead of

hit enter,

its own settings to
